name: photos
description: Private-ish family photo gallery. HEIF in, AVIF out, static site on GitHub Pages.
_overridesNote: Astro pulls sharp in as an optional dependency for astro:assets, which this project never uses (site/fixtures/check.mjs asserts it). The override keeps that copy on the same version the studio runs, so a future Astro bump cannot quietly reintroduce an older sharp and its libvips/libheif CVEs.
